# Dropdown

> Dropdown is a small independent studio in Seoul, South Korea. It makes mobile games and small apps. Contact: hello@dropdown.xyz

## Games
- [TILTDOWN](https://www.dropdown.xyz/game/tiltdown/en): free party game for iPhone and Android. 100 jellies race down one obstacle course and shove each other off. Rounds take about one minute. Friends-only matches for 2 to 12 players with one invite link. More facts: https://tiltdown.vercel.app/llms.txt
- [Dear: Little Fawn Island](https://www.dropdown.xyz/game/dear/en): a quiet game about raising a baby fawn on a tiny island.
- [BREAK ZERO: Seoul Mage Defense](https://www.dropdown.xyz/game/breakzero)
